topic: 限时听力：学术独白与阶段测评
grammarFocus: 学术句子的主干、修饰关系与名词短语；被动表达。
title: Timed Listening and Staged Assessment in University Study
prompt: Some universities now assess students through short, timed listening tests based on academic monologues, followed by staged progress checks, rather than through longer written examinations at the end of a course. Some educators argue that this approach gives a fairer and more useful picture of a student's ability, while others believe it places too much pressure on learners and rewards only quick comprehension. To what extent do you agree or disagree that timed listening assessments with staged progress checks are a better way to measure academic ability than end-of-course written examinations? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先明确你对“限时听力测评配合阶段性检查是否比期末笔试更能衡量学术能力”的立场，并在引言中清楚表明。主体段落应围绕你的立场展开论证：可讨论限时听力对即时理解与注意力的考查价值，也可分析其带来的压力、对慢速学习者是否公平，以及阶段性反馈对学习过程的帮助。每个主体段建议用一个具体理由加一个例子支撑，例子可来自你自己的学习经历，但不要编造官方数据或引用。结尾重申立场并概括主要理由。写作时注意段落之间的逻辑连接，使用多样且准确的句式，避免口语化表达。全文不少于250词，建议用5分钟规划、30分钟写作、5分钟检查。
